title: February 2026: Sparky can read images! Plus, refreshed profile and settings.
summary: Explore Flint’s February 2026 product updates, including updated profile and settings design, reading images in documents, and deeper district analytics.
body_markdown: Workspace Settings now has a cleaner, more intuitive layout. Admins can now bulk add members and change roles through CSV, quickly access Sparky customizations, navigate moderation guidelines, terms, and SIS/LMS integrations more easily. Learn more about[assigning roles to students and teachers](https://help.flintk12.com/en/articles/10629829-assigning-roles-to-students-and-teacher) .
